rows.en: The truth is, a certain weapon got sucked into Antlar's nest.
Thanks to you all defeating Antlar, the magnetic ray has vanished, but the nest was buried as well.
So I'd like you to search where the nest used to be and dig up that weapon.
I'm counting on you.
If you called for me... don't tell me this has something to do with me?
That's right. The thing is, that weapon is the "Hyper Mega Launcher."
What!! You mean it was here in this world!?
Yeah. We'd found it in this area and were in the middle of bringing it back.
Of course, if you find it, you're free to use it.
So that's how it is... Of course I'll take the job!
Great. Well then, I'm counting on you.
So you're the one who'll hear out my request.
The thing is, the other day I accidentally let a certain weapon get sucked into Antlar's nest.
Thanks to you all beating Antlar, the magnetic ray is gone, but the nest got buried too.
I want you to search where the nest was and dig that weapon up.
I'm counting on you.
Have you come to hear my request?
But I believe I asked you to bring Zeta Gundam along...
Hyahhahhahhah!! It's around here, right!?
There's a nice weapon buried here, y'know?
Hm...? What's with you guys?
...You mole bastards!! That's our weapon buried there!!

notes.note: Speaker verified in Quest004.bla Event001: Maganac (CHARA_NAME 79), polite, addressing the whole party. In this script MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N plays row N-2 (rows 2-4 are empty): Zeta-in-party path plays 7-11 -> rows 5-9 (or 10-11 -> rows 8-9 on a repeat visit); no-Zeta path plays 28-29 -> rows 26-27.
Magnetic lines of force rendered 'magnetic ray', matching story_025 (Antlar's Capture Ray / magnetic ray).

Rows 10-16 and 20-24 are not referenced by Quest004.bla (unused draft of the briefing). 10/12/15 = Zeta Gundam (asked to come, the weapon is his); 11/13/14/16 and 20-24 = an unnamed casual client (first person 'boku'), not the polite Maganac. No pronouns used for the client.
Maganac, no-Zeta path. The -sama on Zeta Gundam is dropped per the honorifics rule; politeness carried by tone ('I believe I asked...').

Rows 33-35 and 51-52: Mole Imagin (CHARA_NAME 171 = CharacterName 3.172), three of them on screen. Name not in the glossary 'villains' list but CharacterName already gives 'Mole Imagin'. Trailing full-width space in the source of row 33 dropped.

Rows 36-50 are the leader block (TextIdOffset+38+pt_01_txt). Order from the Event002 Pt_Chara_Check chain: Den-O (Momotaros), 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Zeta, Nu, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W (Shotaro), Black RX, Rider 1. Wording confirms: 36 rough/'mole bastard' = Momotaros, 47 gentle request = OOO, 48 'yo' = Shotaro. Identical Japanese kept identical (37/38/40 differ only by a comma). 'Mogura yarou' made plural since three Mole Imagin are present.
OkWin system message (TextIdOffset+57). Format matches quest_003 'Obtained "...".'

Rows 56-79 and 84-101 are not referenced by Quest004.bla (unused alternative finale where the client shows up at the dig site). 56-70 = 15 identical leader variants. 71/73/75/77/79/98 = the same unnamed casual client; 72 = Zeta Gundam (he took the job). 74/76 inferred as Zeta Gundam (client asks if the weapon was originally his; he says yes), polite wording kept as polite tone.

84-96 (13 rows) and 99-111 (13 rows, ends in quest_005) look like a 13-slot no-Zeta leader block, but no script fixes the order. Voiced from wording: 88 rough ('Zeta no yatsu', 'dakke ka'), 90 polite (Zeta-san), 95 soft 'da ne'. 84 is a terser stand-alone version.
'Zeta' (the nickname form used in the source) kept as 'Zeta'; the full 'Z Gundam' form is written 'Zeta Gundam'.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest004.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N-2 in this table). Played: Maganac 5-9/26-27, Mole Imagin 33-35/51-52, leader block 36-50 (Pt_Chara_Check order), system 55. Unused: 10-16, 20-24, 56-79, 84-101 (unnamed casual client + Zeta; party variants voiced from wording, order unverified). Mole Imagin taken from CharacterName (not in glossary villains).
